details.report: Committed 27a9365. Added one shared verified docket loader for live and recovery, validating the public manifest plus docket/invocation/session/receipt identities, exact receipt/session lengths and SHA-256 digests, receipt schema/tool joins, and sealed child outcome truth. Nonzero child exits remain infrastructure failures and signals remain cancellations rather than accepted role outcomes. Judge converged/continue/escalate now classify from judgeStatus; refusal and recovery outcomes retain their role-specific terminal classes. The latest selected receipt or failure/recovery artifact is digest-verified and admitted exactly once into post-settlement Navigator evidence without promoting environment values or trusting prose. Test-first regression coverage proves Judge escalation evidence admission and tampered digest/length/session/identity rejection. Verification: build:recorder; full suite 394 passed, 0 failed, 5 skipped; typecheck; git diff --check; npm pack --dry-run. No Judge-authorized finding was left unadopted.
